steps.step: Prepare separate Contracts for relations, the confidentiality prompt in both directions, a restricted target, the Matter links, and ending and archiving; and two open Matters
steps.expected: Prerequisite records exist for this role
steps.actual: Open Contracts A=C-98, B=C-99, C=C-100, E=C-101, F=C-102, H=C-103, J=C-104; Confidential D=C-105, G=C-106, I=C-107; open Matters M1=M-32, M2=M-33. Priya Raman is on none of their teams.

steps.step: Set parent: Cancel leaves no parent; Set parent places A under B; B lists A under Children; choosing A as B's parent is refused as a cycle
steps.expected: Parent relation saves; Cancel changes nothing; a parent choice that creates a cycle is refused
steps.actual: Cancel left C-98 with no parent. The picker showed "Set parentC-99DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 B legal_team_member 1790579848658CancelSet parent"; Set parent saved. C-98: "Related contractsAdd linkParentC-99 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 B legal_team_member 1790579848658DraftRemove parent". C-99: "Related contractsSet parentAdd linkChildrenC-98 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 A legal_team_member 1790579848658Draft". Choosing C-98 as C-99's parent was refused: "That contract already sits under this one. Pick another parent."; C-99 still has no parent.

steps.step: Add link Related, Renews and Amends from A to C; check direction on both records; a duplicate Renews is refused; the picker does not offer A itself
steps.expected: Typed links save with the stated direction; self-links and duplicates are refused
steps.actual: Related, Renews and Amends answered 201, 201, 201. C-98: "Related contractsAdd linkParentC-99 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 B legal_team_member 1790579848658DraftRemove parentRelatedC-100 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 C legal_team_member 1790579848658DraftRemove linkRenewsC-100 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 C legal_team_member 1790579848658DraftRemove linkAmendsC-100 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 C legal_team_member 1790579848658DraftRemove link". C-100: "Related contractsSet parentAdd linkRelatedC-98 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 A legal_team_member 1790579848658DraftRemove linkRenewed byC-98 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 A legal_team_member 1790579848658DraftRemove linkAmended byC-98 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 A legal_team_member 1790579848658DraftRemove link". A second Renews answered 409: "These two contracts are already linked that way.". In C-98's own picker a title search found C-99, and a search for C-98's own title offered: "No contracts to link." (not C-98 itself); a direct self-link write answered 409.

steps.step: Remove link on the Related row removes only that relationship; Remove parent clears the parent; both records still exist
steps.expected: Removal affects only the chosen relationship
steps.actual: Links before: amends,related,renews; after Remove link on the Related row: amends,renews (3 rows had named C-100). Remove parent cleared the parent. C-98 now reads "Related contractsSet parentAdd linkRenewsC-100 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 C legal_team_member 1790579848658DraftRemove linkAmendsC-100 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 C legal_team_member 1790579848658DraftRemove link"; C-99 and C-100 still exist.

steps.step: Flag as confidential? after linking Confidential D to open E: the prompt names E and Flag as confidential sets E's flag
steps.expected: The prompt names the Contract that is not yet Confidential and sets only that flag
steps.actual: Prompt: "Flag as confidential?C-105 is confidential but C-101 is not. Flag C-101 as confidential too?No, leave it openFlag as confidential". Flag as confidential (200) set C-101 Confidential; C-105 stays Confidential.

steps.step: Flag as confidential? after linking open F to Confidential G: the prompt names F (this Contract) and accepting sets F's flag
steps.expected: The flagged Contract can be this Contract
steps.actual: Prompt: "Flag as confidential?C-106 is confidential but C-102 is not. Flag C-102 as confidential too?No, leave it openFlag as confidential". Flag as confidential (200) set this Contract C-102 Confidential.

steps.step: No, leave it open after linking open H to Confidential I changes nothing; a reader without access to I sees Restricted contract on H and cannot open I
steps.expected: The link does not change either flag or grant access; the restricted target does not leak its details
steps.actual: Prompt: "Flag as confidential?C-107 is confidential but C-103 is not. Flag C-103 as confidential too?No, leave it openFlag as confidential". No, leave it open kept C-103 open and C-107 Confidential; the link exists. Priya Raman's C-103 card: "Related contractsSet parentAdd linkRelatedRestricted contract" with no link to C-107; a direct read of C-107 answered 404; the relations read does not include its title.

steps.step: Link to Matter: search, inspect the M- reference, Link; the card then offers Unlink and no Link to Matter; Unlink before moving to another Matter; a confidentiality mismatch warns without changing flags
steps.expected: One Matter at a time; the mismatch advice changes neither flag
steps.actual: C-104 search offered "M-32 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 M1 legal_team_member 1790579848658"; Link answered 201; the card then showed 1 Unlink and 0 Link to Matter buttons. A second link to M-33 answered 409. After Unlink, the Contract linked to M-33 (201). Confidential C-105 -> open M-32: the dialog warned "These records have different Confidential flags. Linking will not change either one."; after Link, "Confidentiality differsC-105 and M-32 keep independent Confidential flags. Consider aligning them if that matches the work. This suggestion changes neither record.Leave them as they are"; Leave them as they are kept C-105 Confidential and M-32 open.

steps.step: End: use the Stage control to choose Expired (Ended); check Status and History; the Contract remains editable; the default Contracts view excludes it until Filter -> Show ended; reopen with Active and History keeps the Expired change
steps.expected: Ending records the lifecycle change without freezing the record; the ended filter reveals it; reopening is another recorded change
steps.actual: Stage control -> Expired set Status Expired (stage ended); a Description edit then saved (200). History showed "Nadia Haddad changed the statusDraft → Expiredthis minute". The Contracts list (view "Default view; previously selected My commercial desk") did not list C-104 after paging; Filter -> Show ended ("Filter1") listed it. Choosing Active reopened it (Active); History still shows the Expired change and the Active change.

steps.step: Archive from Contract actions: Archived marker and read-only message; Status unchanged; linked Contract and Matter are not archived and the Matter's Linked Contracts omits it; find it with Show archived plus Show ended; Restore from Contract actions and from the known C- address
steps.expected: Archiving is separate from ending; restore re-enables editing and keeps the Status
steps.actual: Related link to C-100 (201); Status Expired. Archive showed the Archived marker and "This contract is archived — it is out of the contract list. Restore it to edit."; Title was not editable; Status stayed Expired. C-100 and M-33 were not archived; Before archiving M-33's Linked Contracts listed C-104; while archived it read "Linked Contracts0New contractLink ContractNo Contracts are linked to this Matter.". List filter started as "Filter"; Show archived alone ("Filter1") did not list the Ended record; with Show ended too ("Filter2") it did. Restore from Contract actions removed the marker and re-enabled editing; Status still Expired, so the default view still excludes it. Archived again (200), the known /contracts/104 address offered Restore (1) and restored it. Afterwards the reviewer cleared its list filters ("Filter" before) and re-selected view "My commercial desk".
